new_categories.label: cargo_moisture_measurement_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-mass moisture/wetness-condition measurement is a delivered observation service-state distinct from hold-environment humidity monitoring and water-ingress detection.

new_categories.label: cargo_scope_measurement_availability
new_categories.memory: Measurement availability can be bounded to a cargo parcel, hold or zone without retaining exact sampling locations, sample sizes or cargo-specific plans.

new_categories.label: sampling_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: A bounded sampling or measurement interface confidence can be represented separately from the condition result without retaining collection technique or handling steps.

new_categories.label: representativeness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Representativeness of a bounded cargo-moisture observation is distinct from measurement availability and can degrade without retaining sample count, location or statistical rules.

new_categories.label: measurement_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measurement validity can be represented separately from sample representativeness and from the cargo-condition judgment without exact instruments, methods or calibration details.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_moisture_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence in cargo moisture/wetness condition can be retained without exact values, limits, thresholds or acceptance criteria.

new_categories.label: condition_distribution_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that a bounded cargo scope does not hide materially different moisture-condition zones can be represented structurally without retaining exact spatial sampling plans.

new_categories.label: cross_check_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate cross-check confidence is distinct from the primary sample/measurement and can degrade separately without retaining laboratory or field procedures.

new_categories.label: cargo_condition_judgment_not_measurement_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Cargo acceptance, wetness concern or receiver judgment is downstream of, and not equivalent to, sampling/measurement service readiness or representativeness.

new_categories.label: moisture_monitoring_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Cargo-moisture measurement can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to sampling/measurement interface, cargo scope, representativeness, measurement validity, condition confidence or cross-check state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-condition uncertainty, hold restriction, terminal/receiver concern, claims/rework or schedule effects do not prove a sampling, measurement, representativeness or cargo-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_measurement_restoration
new_categories.memory: Sampling/measurement-path correction, representativeness recovery, cross-check verification, restriction release and return to normal cargo-condition assurance can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: environment_humidity_vs_cargo_moisture_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P110 hold-environment humidity monitoring does not establish cargo-mass moisture/wetness-condition measurement.

useful_refinements.label: water_ingress_vs_cargo_moisture_measurement
useful_refinements.memory: P108 water-ingress/bilge service can indicate a source or consequence but does not establish cargo-moisture measurement or representativeness.

useful_refinements.label: temperature_self_heating_vs_moisture_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P119 cargo-temperature/self-heating monitoring is a different cargo-condition dimension from moisture/wetness measurement.

useful_refinements.label: generic_sampling_assurance_vs_dry_cargo_moisture_scope
useful_refinements.memory: P099 liquid-cargo sampling identity/representativeness semantics refine but do not duplicate dry-cargo moisture-condition measurement scope.

duplicates.label: generic_sampling_measurement_representativeness_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic sampling/measurement availability, representativeness, validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.
